title: Linearity of expected random restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\delta$ be real, let $\iota$ be a type, and let $s$ be a finite subset of $\iota$. For each $a\in\iota$, let $g_a(J,z)$ be a real-valued function of a subset $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ and a sign assignment $z$ on its complement. The expected random restriction of the pointwise sum $\sum_{a\in s}g_a$ equals the sum over $a\in s$ of the expected random restrictions of $g_a$.
hypotheses_covered: $\delta$ is real, with no range restriction
$g$ is real-valued on the stated arguments
